chapter: Philadelphia, Atlantic City and the war years
title: Charlie Gaines's band in Philadelphia and Club Harlem
summary: After joining the Philadelphia union board Caldwell worked with Charlie Gaines in Philadelphia and at Club Harlem in Atlantic City.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: -- to starting? Well, I left -- when I went into the executive secretary board and (unintelligible) Philadelphia, then I started to work with Charlie Gaynes, because Charlie had one of the big, best jobs over there because that's his home, and he's worked with Leroy Smith in New York through the years, and then we played the big club there in Philadelphia and then summertime came and we went to Atlantic City to Club Harlem. And he had a hell --
How big a band did he work with?

When we left Philadelphia, we had -- we had seven. Of course, they had some terrific shows to play then. Then we went to the Club Harlem in Atlantic City, we had to run another trumpet player. That was Bob -- Billy Douglas from New Haven, Connecticut
